newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dollar shortfall.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker on dollar shortfall.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker at 43.7480/7495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Wednesday against previous close at 43.7470/7495, dealers said.
The local currency opened at Tuesday's closing level but lost ground later with state-owned banks remaining non-responsive to demands for a second straight day.
"They (state-owned banks) had their own requirement for import payment. Many banks eventually turned to the central bank for dollar," said one dealer with a foreign bank.
The interbank call money rates closed at 6.5 to seven percent against the previous close at 6.5-7.5 percent.
